record.integrity_note: The record publishes MD5 only. A SHA-256 must be computed locally at download time and recorded before any scoring run; MD5 is collision-prone and is treated as transport sanity, not tamper evidence.

license.reason: No explicit licence on the track page, and the advertised bundle URL returned 404 at the inherited audit. Individual input-ontology upstream licences (ENVO CC0 1.0, SWEET CC0 1.0, NCBI Taxonomy CC0 1.0 OBO edition, TAXREF-LD CC BY 3.0 France) do not license the OAEI snapshot or the reference alignments.

excluded_tracks.basis: Reference alignments are UMLS Metathesaurus-derived; SNOMED CT input is LICENCE_REQUIRED (charges/registration may apply outside member territories); UMLS use requires an individual licence and UTS account with source-vocabulary redistribution restrictions. Bundle terminal in the inherited audit: NOT_LAWFUL_PUBLIC_PANEL_READY.

The OAEI 2025 campaign states Bio-ML supersedes LargeBio and Phenotype (recorded in the inherited audit's campaign-status note). Bio-ML itself was not separately audited here; its exclusion rests on the campaign's own succession statement and the LargeBio UMLS/SNOMED entanglement. If Bio-ML is ever wanted, it needs its own metadata-only rights audit before any licence conclusion.

Issue #1086 box 1 excludes eClass unless authorized. eClass is additionally not among the seven OAEI families audited in the bound 2025-campaign audit, so no separate presence, licence or registration status was recorded for it.

other_audited_families_not_selected.note: Inputs are CC BY 4.0 (Adult Mouse Anatomy, NCI Thesaurus anatomy subset per OBO metadata) and the audited reference provenance is MGI-derived (Ringwald/Hayamizu; later Beisswanger) — Anatomy is NOT UMLS-associated in the bound audit and is not excluded under the UMLS rule; it is blocked solely by the missing explicit reference-alignment licence and snapshot-to-upstream mapping.
